<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Barrier''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">完全防備の壁</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手がキャラクターか宇宙船を配備した直後に使用する。１フォース消費すること。そのキャラクターまたは宇宙船は、このターンの間中、戦闘と移動を行うことができない。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Imperial-Barrier-video.png|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Imperial Barrier (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Imperial-Barrier-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">無計画にデス・スターから脱出しようとした一行は、ゴミ圧縮装置の磁気反射ドアに阻まれた。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' A completely fortified wall.

'''Card text:''' Use immediately after the opponent deploys a character or starship. Use 1 Force. That character or starship cannot battle or move during this turn.

'''Lore:''' The group attempting to escape the Death Star without a plan was blocked by the trash compactor's magnetic reflection door.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to a magnetic reflection door; the English calls it a magnetically sealed door.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Barrier]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
